I stayed here for one night only, and while there were some positives, the overall experience was not great.

On the positive side, the room matched the pictures, and the staff were friendly. I was offered water at reception, allowed to check in late at 1am, and even check out late at 2pm, which I really appreciated.

Unfortunately, that’s where the good part mostly ends.

The Wi-Fi was extremely slow and unreliable, despite being told it was fast. The TV had very limited channels, and surprisingly Al Jazeera was missing. The carpet was very dirty, and clearly not well maintained.

The worst part was the outside noise. My window faced a Haraj market, and from 1am until morning there was constant noise from cars, people, and banging sounds. The sound insulation was almost zero. I couldn’t sleep properly at all.

The bed was quite stiff, and the towels in the bathroom smelled bad and looked very old and worn.

I don’t think I’ll be coming back. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and fixes these issues for future guests.

**Exceptional Service & Strategic Location**

Unforgettable Hospitality: The staff at Al Aseel Hotel were the absolute highlight of my first trip to Doha. Their genuine kindness and hospitality were unparalleled. As a solo female American traveler, the team (specifically Gangadhar, Hnin, Ananya, Akilesh, and Tika) immediately put me at ease regarding the neighborhood and the safety of Doha, one of the safest cities in the world.

Above and Beyond: The personalized service was outstanding. Tika insisted on handling my luggage right to the room upon arrival. When I asked for directions to the Metro, Gangadhar even walked me across the street to clearly explain the route—a level of care I truly appreciated.

The hotel’s thoughtfulness extended to my departure; Hnin and Gangadhar offered me an extended late check-out to accommodate my very late 1 AM flight, which was an exceptionally kind and generous gesture.

Spacious Comfort & Amenities (Room 701):

I stayed in a Standard Room (701, top floor, corner room), which was surprisingly spacious—far larger than my recent stays in Europe. The bed was superb; firm, comfortable, and a huge benefit for my chronic back pain.

Noise Level: Despite a nightclub below, the top-floor room was reasonably quiet for light sleepers like myself, allowing for a restful night's sleep.

Air Conditioning (AC): AC was available and functional within the room.

Convenience: The room was well-appointed with a safe, mini-fridge, hot water kettle, complimentary water, and a huge array of quality toiletries, including plush slippers. Housekeeping was attentive, and the front desk courteously handled my Talabat food delivery arrival.

Location: The hotel's location is strategic, balancing comfort and value perfectly. This central spot provides quick access to the Corniche, Souq Waqif, and all Metro-serviced areas. The immediate vicinity offers a wide and appealing mix of pocketbook-friendly, authentic Asian, Indian, and African restaurants, alongside fine dining options.

Metro Access: Superb, with the Al Doha Al Jadeda Metro Station just a 5–10 minute walk away (or a quick ~5 QAR ride if you prefer to avoid the heat).

Minor Note on Condition: A few elements, such as the room carpeting, appeared worn, and the sauna was under maintenance during my visit. Room service availability may be limited (check for current menu items and pricing). These points, however, are easily overshadowed by the fantastic comfort and the five-star service provided by the staff.

I rarely give feedback but I’ve decided to share my experience about this hotel because they well deserve it! My mother and I just came to Qatar from a long trip, we are both American citizens. From the night we came in, we had nothing but professional and hospitable service. In terms of the rooms, they are very clean and comfortable, we instantly felt like we were home not just guest. Room service is also exceptional.

I want to personally give a shout out to Mohamed Harrish for welcoming us. He was extremely kind, considerate, and just downright amazing. He deserves to be recognized and I definitely recommend him to management roles. If I had to come back to this hotel in the near future, Mohamed Harrish would be the main reason I would be back.

Thank you Al Aseel!
